subject: Mutual Action Plan — Archimedes Bio evaluation & 60-day timeline
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@archimedesbio.com>, Priya Singh <p.singh@archimedesbio.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan — Archimedes Bio evaluation & 60-day timeline

Laura / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a short mutual action plan (attached) to align on scope, stakeholders, success criteria, and a proposed 60-day timeline so we can get you from PoC to production-readiness.

High-level goals (as I heard them):
- Validate Redwood inference for batch clinical note embeddings and real-time triage latency < 200ms for short prompts
- Measure cost per 1M tokens and projection for production usage
- Confirm security posture for SOC2 and data retention (audit trail)

Proposed 60-day outline (draft):
1) Week 1: kickoff, stakeholder roster, config & test dataset
2) Weeks 2–3: PoC runs, latency/cost baseline, quantization test
3) Weeks 4–6: quality evals, regression checks, ops playbook
4) Weeks 7–8: rollout plan, SLA review, ramp plan

Owners:
- Redwood AE / project lead: Neha Kapoor
- Redwood CSM: Marcus Lin (cc'd)
- Archimedes champion: Laura Chen
- Archimedes engineering contact: Priya Singh

Attachments:
- archimedes-map-charter-v0.1.pdf (MAP charter)
- mutual-action-plan-sheet.xlsx (owners, dates, risks)

Next steps: can we schedule a 30–45m kickoff this week to walk through the attached and confirm owners? I included three windows below — please pick one or propose alternatives.
- Tue 8/10 10:00–10:45 PDT
- Tue 8/10 15:00–15:45 PDT
- Wed 8/11 09:00–09:45 PDT

If you prefer I can also share a short Drive folder with SOC2 evidence and our public security overview (link in follow-up).

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan — Archimedes Bio evaluation & 60-day timeline

Thanks, Neha — really helpful summary and a good starting point.

A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Our primary success metrics are 1) latency at P95 < 250ms for single-turn queries and 2) embeddings recall parity > 95% against our existing model on the validation set.
- We need SOC2 artifacts and evidence of tenant isolation for any shared staging environment before we run customer data there. Can you include where you store audit logs and how long they are retained?
- Legal will want a high-level timeline for procurement & contracts. If we can keep an accelerated path to sign (60 days), procurement will likely request a POC extension clause.

Stakeholders I will add to the kickoff invite: Tom Hall (Security), Priya (Engineering), and Mara Lopez (Head of Data; will observe). If Mara needs to be looped earlier I will forward.

For the meeting, Tue 8/10 15:00–15:45 PDT works for me.

Laura
Laura Chen | Director, ML Infrastructure
Archimedes Bio
laura.chen@archimedesbio.com | 617-555-0199

Great — thanks for confirming, Laura.

Quick answers to the questions you raised:
- SOC2 and audit logs: we can share a redacted SOC2 report and an evidence pack (control matrix, logging architecture). We retain audit logs for 13 months by default; retention can be adjusted with an enterprise agreement. I attached a short security one-pager and added the Drive link below.
- Tenant isolation: for the Dedicated trial we'll provision a logically isolated tenant; I listed technical contacts and a short description in the attached MAP charter.
- Procurement timeline: we'll include a proposed procurement checkpoint in Week 6 and an optional 30-day POC extension clause in the draft contract.

Kickoff: I've scheduled Tue 8/10 15:00–15:45 PDT and sent a calendar invite to the stakeholders you listed. Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/rb-map-kickoff

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4MapDraft
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Looking forward to the kick-off. Marcus will lead the ops/runbook discussion in the meeting.

Best,
Neha
